```python
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import chi2, t

data = np.loadtxt(
    "code/data/order-processing-times.csv",
    delimiter=",",
    skiprows=1,
)
n, alpha = data.size, 0.05
mean = data.mean()
variance = data.var(ddof=1)
std = np.sqrt(variance)

t_critical = t.ppf(1 - alpha / 2, df=n - 1)
margin = t_critical * std / np.sqrt(n)
mean_interval = (mean - margin, mean + margin)

chi2_low = chi2.ppf(alpha / 2, df=n - 1)
chi2_high = chi2.ppf(1 - alpha / 2, df=n - 1)
variance_interval = (
    (n - 1) * variance / chi2_high,
    (n - 1) * variance / chi2_low,
)
std_interval = tuple(np.sqrt(variance_interval))
```
